title: Lonely Neighborhood
content: This is the place I visit most often when I have a recurring dream. It’s like a banal, sterile, and very lonely community that is nestled in some fields. I think I’m a kid again when I’m in this place. There’s nobody around, but it’s not empty. It’s like everybody is off somewhere else doing something. In the dreams I’m usually home alone, maybe standing in the back yard or looking out a window. The other day I watched Napoleon Dynamite again, and this place feels a lot like that, but just very melancholic too
